decision_boundary.decision_timestamp_semantics: the decision at D 00:00 UTC may use only source observations completed strictly before D 00:00 UTC

strategy_daily_close.common_history_policy: start at the latest first available canonical day across BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB, then require every UTC day through the latest required session
strategy_daily_close.mapping_change_policy: mapping periods must be explicit, non-overlapping and gap-free for any session consumed; historical mappings are never silently rewritten

basis.verified_spot_price: midpoint of the verified Hyperliquid spot L2 book for the same economic asset
basis.timestamp_policy: record both source observation timestamps; neither observation may be after router_as_of_ms; preserve observed skew for replay

determinism.numeric_policy: finite positive daily closes; no implicit rounding before model consumption
determinism.research_live_rule: research and live adapters must emit byte-equivalent canonical payloads for the same raw observations and decision/as-of timestamps

source_notes: Frozen BRRK research core used Binance spot BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT/BNBUSDT daily closes.
Binance klines are keyed by open time and default timezone 0 is UTC; P3.1 makes timeZone=0 explicit.
Hyperliquid router market inputs remain execution-venue observations and are not substituted for the frozen BRRK strategy close series.
